summary: Added a capability-limited guest gateway and iPad-oriented experiment terminal that project live ICARUS state read-only while keeping guest inputs, presets, backtests and replay rewarms isolated from the live runtime. Guest sharing is opt-in, uses a distinct capability token and guest port, and tunnels only the guest surface. All live admin, execution and research-mutation routes are denied. Guest replay compute is hard-limited to one active experiment at a time, and the guest can read only replay jobs created by its own workspace.
surface: ICARUS guest viewer / isolated experiment sandbox
evidence: GitHub Actions guest isolation, UI-contract, activation and replay-resource test runs
